title: Dependency Risk Caveat Scope v1
description: Machine-readable artifact that scopes an unresolved dependency-risk caveat for assessment interpretation. It deliberately does NOT remediate the risk and does NOT grant security/production readiness or a result_assessment. It records scope_status, that the risk is not remediated, whether result_assessment/comparison are allowed after scoping, an audit observation, an assessment interpretation, and an anti-overclaim does_not_establish boundary. v1 models exactly one real scope_status, scoped_not_remediated; no other status is permitted, and remediation (dependency_risk_remediated=true or audit_observation.remediation_performed=true) is out of scope and must be represented by a future separate contract/PR. Form is validated here; semantic rules (scoped_not_remediated coupling, remediation out-of-scope, audit-exit coupling incl. result_assessment/comparison, mandatory does_not_establish, source-evidence existence/escape, challenge_version existence) are enforced by scripts/docmeta/validate_dependency_risk_caveat_scope.py.

scope_status.$comment: v1 models exactly one real status: scoped_not_remediated, the only enum member. No other status is permitted; if there is no dependency-risk caveat to scope, no dependency-risk-caveat-scope artifact should be emitted. Semantic rules: 'scoped_not_remediated' requires dependency_risk_remediated=false, security/production readiness 'blocked', result_assessment_allowed_after_scope=false, comparison_ready_after_scope=false, and the matching assessment_interpretation strings. dependency_risk_remediated=true and audit_observation.remediation_performed=true are rejected (DEPENDENCY_RISK_REMEDIATED_OUT_OF_SCOPE / REMEDIATION_PERFORMED_OUT_OF_SCOPE).

dependency_risk_remediated.$comment: In v1 this must be false. true is rejected by the validator (DEPENDENCY_RISK_REMEDIATED_OUT_OF_SCOPE) regardless of scope_status; remediation belongs in a future separate contract/PR.

audit_exit_code.$comment: A non-zero integer is semantically coupled (validator) to dependency_risk_remediated=false and blocked security/production readiness.

remediation_performed.$comment: In v1 this must be false. true is rejected by the validator (REMEDIATION_PERFORMED_OUT_OF_SCOPE); remediation belongs in a future separate contract/PR.

comparison_ready.$comment: String, not boolean. Under scope_status=scoped_not_remediated the validator requires the literal string 'false'.

does_not_establish.$comment: Mandatory anti-overclaim list. Must include the baseline non-claims enforced by the validator: security_readiness, production_readiness, absence_of_vulnerabilities, dependency_risk_remediated, dependency_tree_safe, supply_chain_safety, production_dependency_health, security_approval, model_quality, comparative_superiority, condition_effect, outcome_upgrade, adoption_readiness, promotion_readiness, absence_of_regressions, external_model_independence, production_correctness, outcome_assessment.

repoRelativePath.$comment: Repo-relative POSIX path. Absolute paths, drive letters and backslashes are rejected here; parent-escape ('..') and symlink-out-of-repo are rejected semantically by the validator with a stable rule id.
